Name: Vanity Recolor to Match Bed (for Get Dressed Mod)
Author: joyous1ariella
Description:
For use with the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/331/?]Get Dressed[/url] mod by jinxiewinxie. All creds to them for the amazing mod.

Installation:
1. Find your install directory for the Get Dressed mod and go into the override folders (mine is C:\GOG Games\Stardew Valley\Mods\GetDressed\overrides).
2. Extract the .rar to that folder using [url=http://www.rarlab.com/download.htm]WinRar[/url] or similar program.
3. Enjoy your new vanity that matches your bed :)


If something in the instructions is unclear, lemme know.
Also, if the recolor isn't working, lemme know.

-Ariella
